question: The Largest possible sphere is carved from a cube of side 6 cm. What is the volume of the sphere?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For the **largest sphere** inside a **cube**, the **diameter** of the sphere = **side** of the cube.

Diameter = 6 cm → Radius (r) = 3 cm.

Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × 3³ = 4 × (22/7) × 9 = 792/7 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 792/7 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Side of **cube** (a) = 6 cm.

**Formula Used:** Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b327884a46f74322c21e066b217b25bcc8e50dfabc18ef925bf0531663cec997.png] 

⇒ **Diameter** of the sphere = Side of the cube = 6 cm

⇒ **Radius** (r) = Diameter ÷ 2 = 6 ÷ 2 = 3 cm

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × (3)³

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × 27

⇒ Volume = 4 × (22/7) × 9

⇒ Volume = 792/7 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 792/7 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cube and Sphere Relationship

When a sphere is inscribed in a cube, the **diameter** of the sphere is equal to the **edge** of the cube (d = a).

Volume of Sphere

The volume of a sphere with radius r is given by V = (4/3)πr³.

Surface Area

Surface Area of a sphere = 4πr². Total Surface Area of a cube = 6a².</p
